albums.body:
Flowers of My Mediterranean Garden

June 5, 2017

On the occasion of #WorldEnvironmentDay 2017 I am posting flowers of my Mediterranean garden in Montenegro. Nature is not my environment – it is embedded in me and significant part of my professional career I spent in efforts to protect the nature. Whenever I am visiting my garden I’m reconnecting with nature and celebrating this places that matter to me. I hope you will enjoy browsing these photos. Get connect and pay quick visit if you are passing by.

Interested in those places? Get in touch with me today.

albums.body:
This gallery brings together photographs from conferences, workshops and fieldwork organised within WATER SUM — Sustainable Use of Transboundary Water Resources and Water Security Management. The project supported cooperation on water challenges in the Middle East and North Africa, focusing on Tunisia, Egypt and Jordan.

The photographs capture opportunities for dialogue, shared learning and practical engagement with water management challenges. These activities connected institutions, experts and local stakeholders around integrated water resources management, climate adaptation and community water security.

Implemented by the Regional Environmental Center for Central and Eastern Europe (REC) with funding from Sweden through Sida, WATER SUM combined regional knowledge exchange with local action planning. As Project Director, I oversaw implementation quality and supported coordination among the project team, beneficiaries and donor.

albums.body:
This gallery brings together photographs from conferences, workshops and fieldwork within TOUR — TOURists friends of the environment. The project connected partners and stakeholders from Italy, Albania and Montenegro to advance environmentally responsible tourism in the South Adriatic.

From discussions with tourism operators and local communities to visits exploring natural landscapes and conservation practices, these activities created opportunities to exchange experience and develop practical approaches to ecotourism. They supported a shared vision linking environmental protection, cultural heritage and local economic opportunities.

As Tourism and Conservation Specialist, contracted by the Tourism Organisation of Kotor, I supported workshops, business exchanges and conference preparation in Montenegro, helping connect tourism development with the conservation of natural landscapes.

albums.body:
This gallery brings together photographs from stakeholder engagement, consultation and learning activities within AZA4ICE — Allocated Zones for Circular Aquaculture to Trigger the Transition to an Inclusive Circular Economy.

Focusing on Montenegro and the Šasko Lake pilot area, these activities connected public authorities, businesses, researchers and community representatives to explore practical pathways towards circular aquaculture. Through the Living Responsible Research and Innovation Ecosystem (LiRRIE), participants shared knowledge, discussed local challenges and helped shape a common vision for responsible aquaculture development.

Contracted by the Chamber of Commerce of Montenegro, I supported stakeholder mapping, facilitated consultations and delivered training on circular aquaculture and business transformation. This collaborative work informed Montenegro’s Circular Aquaculture Action Plan and approaches for continued cooperation and transfer of project results.

albums.body:
This gallery captures moments from the SECAP workshop held on Fruška Gora, Serbia, in December 2023. The workshop formed part of the support for developing Sustainable Energy and Climate Action Plans within GIZ’s regional programme for energy, transport and climate protection.

The gathering provided an opportunity to exchange knowledge and discuss approaches to translating energy and climate objectives into practical municipal measures. SECAP preparation connects greenhouse gas emission reduction, climate adaptation and equitable access to sustainable energy with local development priorities.

As Country Expert Team Leader for Serbia, commissioned by ibf expertise under its contract with GIZ, I coordinated expert support for SECAP development in Novi Sad, Pirot, Valjevo and Vranje.

albums.body:
This gallery brings together photographs from workshops, project meetings, a study visit and conferences within BLUECONNECT — Enhancing Cross-Border Blue Growth: Fostering Innovation and Cooperation for Competitive Entrepreneurship.

These activities connect project partners and stakeholders across Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Montenegro, creating opportunities to exchange knowledge, explore practical solutions and build partnerships for a sustainable blue economy. They support cooperation around aquaculture, fisheries monitoring and resource-efficient fish processing, alongside the development of the Adriatic Blue Growth Cluster and its digital collaboration platform.

As Blue Growth Collaboration Platform Expert, contracted by the Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro, I support platform development, stakeholder engagement and cooperation arrangements. My ongoing work helps connect businesses, researchers and public authorities and establish a basis for collaboration beyond the project.
